name: video-shot-prompts-mobile
description: Analyze local and social videos or create wool-felting storyboards from bundled process references, generate previews, build slideshow videos, and optionally publish through Buffer.

interface.shortDescription: Analyze videos or create wool-felting storyboards.
interface.longDescription: Analyze local, Douyin, or TikTok videos shot by shot, or use bundled wool-felting process references when no video is supplied. Create 6-8 continuity-aware prompts, generate previews with ImageGen when available, build slideshow videos, and optionally publish finished videos through Buffer using Tencent COS-hosted media.
defaultPrompt: Analyze this uploaded video shot by shot.
Without a video, create an 8-shot wool-felting process storyboard from the bundled references.
Turn this video into generation prompts and previews.
Compare this image with the matching video shot.
Publish the finished video through Buffer.
